definition: the striped part of a road for crossing
description: A Paris street corner with a red-awninged cafe and a cyclist waiting. A woman in a red beret and a striped top, holding a baguette, walks towards the camera along the broad white bars painted across the road, with the pedestrian light green beside her. The shot then cuts to the wide bar-painted crossing in front of the Arc de Triomphe, filled with people walking across in both directions, and she walks up the middle of it towards the camera.

de.answer: Sie trägt ein Baguette über den Zebrastreifen.
de.question: Was trägt die Frau?

es.answer: Está llevando una baguette por el paso de peatones.
phrases: pasar pedaleando por delante del café
